holderPosition.legalForm: Stablecoin Loan Token: an unsecured loan participation in one Loan Series owed by a Panama issuer subsidiary of Tessera Works Foundation, repayable only out of Liquidity Event Proceeds that issuer receives, under Singapore law with SIAC arbitration
holderPosition.says: The holder is an unsecured lender to one named Panama issuer (SPX, KLSH or OPAI Tessera Issuer Inc.) for its pro rata share of the series principal, payable in USDC or USDT only after the issuer divests its PE Investment, receives the proceeds and a Redemption Period opens; unclaimed amounts are forfeited after 90 days. No legal, beneficial or proprietary interest in the proceeds, the PE Investment or any issuer asset, and no shareholder rights.

statements.says: The redemption docs describe the Liquidity Event as an IPO or a change of control; the prevailing Terms define it as the issuer's own divestment of all interests in the PE Investment. An IPO or takeover does not itself trigger redemption, and the 90-day clock starts only on receipt of proceeds in full.

A freeze key the docs do not list was used on 2026-06-07 on two T-SpaceX accounts, each thawed within three minutes; one key without a time lock holds mint, fee config, metadata and program upgrade authority since the Squads multisig was replaced on 2026-01-28.

outside.topic: When and how a holder is paid
outside.says: Burn to the Tessera contracts during a 90-day Redemption Period (10am Panama time on the start date to 10pm on the 90th day); after it the amount ceases to be claimable and the issuer is discharged. Stays in the Terms (s. 2.2).
TWF may change the Terms in its sole discretion with no notice period, consent or put; an issuer may be substituted by novation with notice by publication (ss. 9, 11.6, 11.7).
Singapore law; SIAC arbitration seated in Singapore, sole arbitrator; Singapore International Commercial Court for related proceedings.
The only published rationale is automated threat response by Hypernative with independent co-approval, live since 1 June 2026 (Threat Monitoring docs). The Terms do not describe the freeze key.
Primary issuance through Alpha Vault pro-rata auctions and direct acquisition; secondary on Meteora and Jupiter. Nothing pins price to the mark, since redemption pays proceeds, not the mark.

verdict.summary: The outline can be said: named issuers sign T, TWF signs A and the event certifications, Chainlink carries a backed status, and Accretion's code audit is a real third-party report. The core is a contingent, unsecured claim payable only out of proceeds the issuer chooses to realise, which 'issuer-obligation' does not distinguish from a plain debt, and the asset counts are neither units v3 knows nor statements the reader can read. The SPC, its custodian, the portfolio auditors and counsel are all unnamed, and the mints are Token-2022.
